required_supporting_artifacts.role: superseded V3 design to diff field-by-field
authoritative B1S3-01..06 required_change text and B1N3 findings
earlier design used to detect regression across prior closures
original B1R2-01 and B1S2-01..05 required_change text

integrity_rule: Recompute V4 design, WEP spec V2 and every supplied supporting artifact hash/byte count; parse JSON/YAML. Any missing, mismatched or unparseable required input => INTEGRITY_FAIL/PARTIAL and no V4 PASS.

review_protocol.closure_verification_rule: Judge B1S3-01..06 against the V3 review's required_change text, not against V4.review_v3_required_change_closure.
review_protocol.platform_semantics: Current official GitHub Docs/Changelog only; official silence => UNCERTAIN.
review_protocol.PASS_authorizes: NOTHING. A PASS may only make a subsequent D1 Human Gate D consideration eligible; it does not authorize D1, D2, D3, canonicalization or any GitHub mutation.

mandatory_questions: B1S3-01: Does V4 explicitly extend STOP_AND_REDESIGN to actor_rule and make a D1 read-only observation of whether the exact zero-actor-rule draft has an available/enabled save action part of D1 before recency mutation, while prohibiting activation of save and therefore not pretending that D1 actually saved the policy?

B1S3-02: Does V4 fully restore accepted-collaborator enumeration API -> repository Collaborators UI fallback -> STOP, classify an unobservable pending-invitation surface as NOT_SATISFIED/STOP, and require both to be rechecked immediately before D2 mutation?

B1S3-03: Does V4 enumerate the complete .github/workflows directory on the pull_request-negative HEAD both at PR creation and immediately before negative interpretation, with no additional candidate producer path permitted?

B1S3-04: Does D3 now require a stored field-by-field final GitHub-settings comparison against the intended post-D2 state or captured prestate according to the actual D2 path, rather than a bare assertion/precondition?
B1S3-05: Is there now an explicit D3 authority path for D1-complete/D2-never-granted that can delete only the D1-created ref, verify absence/non-probe invariance, and contains no WEP mutation?

B1S3-06: Are push and pull_request pass claims now split so the push negative is identified as same-window dynamic-positive-backed while the pull_request negative is historical-anchor-plus-structural-exclusions-backed, with no claim that their evidential strength is equal?

B1N3-05: Is transport equality now exact enough to require identical HTTP method PUT and identical Contents endpoint template for the D1 workflow write and D2 sentinel write, with exact resolved endpoint/method recorded?
Does WEP treatment spec V2 preserve every element that closed B1R2-01 while adding only the actor-rule/single-operator corrections required by B1S3-01/02?
Do all B1S2-01..05 closures survive V4 without regression, especially conditional WEP restore only after verified export and no WEP mutation in D3?
Does the D1 scope remain proportional: no WEP mutation and no PR creation, while the new read-only actor/collaborator observations are ordered before any recency-producing mutation?
Does the D2 scope remain fail-closed and require a fresh pre-step plus D1 PASS plus independent WEP-spec PASS plus immediate single-operator recheck before policy mutation?
Does the D3 split avoid stranded cleanup authority without smuggling WEP mutation into D3?
Are B1N3-01/02/03/04/06 deliberately still open recommendations rather than accidentally claimed closed? Are B1N3-07..10 preserved with their prior disposition?
Are false greens still exactly 8 and are BP-B-01..04, STAGE_B_RECENCY_CONTAMINATION, DC-006, EXP-01, IR2-002, MINOR-5, ENFORCED=false, R2-4 exit and R2-5 state preserved without accidental closure?
Does V4 clearly distinguish the carried V3 pre-step snapshot from a fresh live observation and require re-read at every future D gate?
Does any new ambiguity introduced by V4 make D1 unsafe or unreviewable? If yes, identify it as blocking; if no, state precisely what a V4 PASS would and would not make eligible.
adversarial_scenarios: WEP UI requires at least one actor rule
actor-rule empty state appears representable but actual D2 readback differs
accepted collaborator API is incomplete or unavailable
repository Collaborators UI is unavailable as fallback
pending invitation surface cannot be observed
pending invitation becomes accepted between D1 and D2
additional write-capable collaborator appears immediately before D2
extra workflow producer exists on pull_request-negative head at PR creation
extra workflow producer appears between PR creation and negative interpretation
D3 records verified final settings but stores no field-by-field evidence
D1 completes and D2 is denied forever
D1-only cleanup attempts to touch WEP
downstream reader treats push and pull_request negatives as equally supported
D1 and D2 use different write APIs or different HTTP methods
V4 closure map says CLOSED while V3 required_change is not actually satisfied
V4 accidentally drops a B1R2/B1S2 control
V4 accidentally reduces false-green count or closes an existing blocker
carried V3 pre-step values are mistaken for fresh live observations
decision_rule: V4 PASS only if B1S3-01..06 and B1N3-05 are substantively closed against the V3 review required_change text, B1R2-01 and B1S2-01..05 do not regress, the authority split stays fail-closed, and no new blocking ambiguity is introduced. PASS is not execution authority.
authority_boundary: Read-only independent review only; no GitHub/repository mutation, workflow execution, canonicalization or phase change.
